fact: A circular of the tax directorate (DGI) dated 22 September 2025, under article 8 of the 2026 finance law, requires the annual salary statement to carry the national identification number (NIN) of each beneficiary of payments, so the tax return is keyed on the NIN.
title: L'Algérie rend obligatoire la télédéclaration des salaires pour les entreprises
